'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Scott Church LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Scott Church]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Printed list (expanded).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
